pages.text: $(italic)Lucky, efficient, and oddly hard to hit. Halflings thrive in exploration and resource-gathering builds.$(/italic)$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$(/bold)$(br2)$(bold)Fortune's Favor$(/bold) — +8% luck stat. Affects loot table rolls, fishing, and Fortune enchant effectiveness.$(br2)$(bold)Food Efficiency$(/bold) — -20% food drain rate. The best food economy in the pack.$(br2)$(bold)Small$(/bold) — -15% hitbox size bonus (harder to hit with projectiles). No movement penalty unlike vanilla.$(br2)$(bold)Halfling Luck$(/bold) — Once per death: 10% chance to survive a killing blow at 1 HP. Cooldown: 20 min.
